text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Coming off the fourth corner and approaching the front of the grandstands... to be completely honest, for a second there, I felt the strength leave my legs.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(A deafening roar. Countless gazes.
Voices, voices, voices surrounding me—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I almost thought I was backsliding again... but!)
choice_data_list: Dober! Show them how strong you are!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, I'll, do it!!
Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Watch me!!
Hyaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(My vision's spinning...! My legs are completely wobbling!
My heart feels like it's gonna explode...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still... that's how much I...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I gave it... everything I had just now...!
Right here... in this race!!
(Waaaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer.
choice_data_list: You saw it through to the end!
You saw it through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Y-You're exaggerating. It's only the first step, right?
What's the point of getting this excited already?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
C-Come on, I've only just debuted!
If you get that happy for me... it's, well, kind of embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, well... that is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, sorry, that was a lie.
To be honest... I'm really happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I was able to run without any regrets.
So for that... I guess I'm grateful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Your voice reached me loud and clear.
...Thanks, Trainer.
Afterward, while getting ready to leave in the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pardon me~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober!
Great job on your debut race~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright... thank you.
Thanks to you, I made it to the end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You were so cool, Dober!
The rhythm of your muscles reached all the way to the stands!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: T-That's just a metaphor, right!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, thank you.
I'm glad to hear you say that."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That was a magnificent, splendid run.
...Keep striving on the road ahead as well, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Senpai...!
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu... Dober, next time,
please be sure to keep your eyes on me as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Without fail, I shall follow right behind you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I'll come cheer for you too... so do your best.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—Coming up next:
a special feature on Twinkle's most promising rookies!”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Dober, who recently made her racing debut!
As a rising talent of the Mejiro family, attention is already focused on her future—"

...The public is already praising Mejiro Dober as the hope of the Mejiro family.
I must brace myself and stay even more focused from now on...!
